decision.observation: 4 mph, gear 1, timer 50:46.799, red X lit. The car has drifted right off the gravel onto the grass beside the grey barn; the road body is roughly one car width to its left, running up-frame and bending left toward the Oil-banner fence and lake.
decision.hypothesis: The A beat was too weak against the drift and steering bled 10->4. The road is immediately left, so a short W+A at this low speed should pull the car back onto the gravel without a pin.
decision.memory: Steering bleed at ~10 mph is brutal (10->4 on a 0.5 s beat) and the car still drifted right. On this left bend the drift beats the steer, so correct in smaller, repeated beats rather than one longer hold.
